profile.headline: Senior Application Developer | Data Engineering & HR Technology | SQL, Oracle APEX & Workday
profile.summary:
I’m a senior software and data professional with 12+ years of experience building technology solutions that connect complex business needs with practical, scalable technical solutions. My career has taken me through several sides of the technology world - starting in HR business analysis and reporting, then moving into database development, business intelligence, application development, HR systems, and now software development and data modernization. That range has become one of my biggest strengths: I understand both the business problem someone is trying to solve and the technical architecture required to solve it well.
A lot of my work has centered around HR technology and data, where I’ve had the opportunity to work with systems and platforms including SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS, Snowflake, Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Workday, Oracle HCM, Oracle APEX, Power Apps, Power Automate, and SharePoint. I’ve worked across the full solution lifecycle - from gathering requirements and designing an approach to development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and long-term support. 
Beyond the technical work itself, I enjoy being the person people can come to when a problem is complicated, unclear, or somewhere between business problem and technical problem. I’ve served as a technical resource and mentor for teammates, led training and knowledge-sharing efforts, coordinated cross-functional initiatives, and worked closely with business partners to turn requirements into solutions that are actually usable.

positions.title: Solution Designer
positions.description: I support and develop tools like SQL, Management Studio, Excel, Oracle, PeopleSoft, MyBI, and other tools like Tableau for Cerner's Human Resources department. This also include maintaining processes for, querying and reporting out, and analyzing human capital data to make informed decisions.

positions.title: Marketing/Social Media/PR Intern
positions.description: I help to engage with current and potential clients. I interact through various social media outlets like Facebook, Twitter, and Flywheel’s blog, and so I also manage these outlets. For PR, I reach out towards bloggers and the press to help gain more traction for Flywheel. I also help brainstorm and implement different marketing strategies to help with brand development.

positions.title: Client Relations and Operations
positions.description: I worked for a start-up company for my Design Studio class. I helped with getting clients on-board, user testing, developing business strategies, creating marketing plans, and other things that go into starting a business.

positions.title: Supply Chain Intern
positions.description: I work in the Transportation/Operations department at Hayneedle that handles both domestic and international inbound and outbound delivery. Currently I am working on the LTL Upgrade project where Hayneedle will now offer customers the ability to upgrade their delivery service. This includes analyzing business structures, making business decisions on which carriers to use, calculating costs, and researching competition.

positions.title: Database Management Intern
positions.description: I took secured files from hospitals, ran queries on them in Microsoft Access so they would fit certain criteria, and exported them to the servers for interviewing to use. I kept track of numerous projects for each hospital and how to organize and maintain the data for each project in a database.

positions.title: Temporary Survey Designer
positions.description: I set up surveys in new server and transferred data to new program. Also checked for spelling/grammar errors as well as keep the information in the correct order.

positions.title: Interviewer
positions.description:
Part-time job.
Called recent patients from client hospitals and completed survey about their satisfaction.
Called random numbers within a community and asked about health practices to improve healthcare in that community.
